subject: Security follow-up: pen-test report request, handback SLAs & disclosure plan
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Morales <lisa.morales@medisia.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Sep 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo follow-up — SOC 2 / pen test and vuln ops next steps

Hi Lisa,

Thanks again for taking the demo earlier — appreciate the clear context on your ingestion volumes and PHI handling on the HL7 side. As discussed, two items we want to align on to keep the procurement track moving:

1) SOC 2 status: you mentioned a public SOC 2 report would be required for your security review. We are SOC 2 Type II compliant; I attached our SOC 2 summary and a short compliance one-pager. If you need the full report, we typically provide a redacted copy under an NDA — happy to coordinate that.

2) Pen test / vulnerability handling: Per your security team's ask, we'd like to kickoff a formal request for (a) any recent external penetration test reports you require from vendors, and (b) our vulnerability management workflow. To make this concrete, can you confirm the following:
  - Who on your side owns vendor pen-test artifact intake (email or S3 bucket)?
  - Desired SLA for vulnerability acknowledgement and remediation SLAs (e.g., 3 business days to acknowledge, 30/90-day remediation windows depending on severity)?
  - Disclosure policy: does Medisia require coordinated disclosure windows and a public timeline for fixes?

I've attached a short Pen Test Request template (medisia-pen-test-request.pdf) that outlines what we can provide and typical redaction practice. Also attached our guidelines (redwood-pen-test-guidelines.pdf).

Proposed next steps:
- If security prefers, we can bring in our remediation lead (Logan) and our compliance manager (Stephanie) for a quick 30-min intake this week to understand the artifact format you prefer and confirm SLA expectations.
- Alternatively, fill out the attached questionnaire and we will respond with timelines.

Would Wednesday 9/29 11:00am PT work for a short intake?

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0143

Attachments: medisia-pen-test-request.pdf (pdf), redwood-pen-test-guidelines.pdf (pdf)
From: Lisa Morales <lisa.morales@medisia.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: security@medisia.com
Date: Thu, 23 Sep 2027 14:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo follow-up — SOC 2 / pen test and vuln ops next steps

Thanks Marissa — that helps. Quick answers from our side:

- Vendor artifact intake is handled by our InfoSec intake queue (security@medisia.com). We prefer S3 links with time-limited access for large artifacts; small PDFs can be attached to email.
- SLA expectations: we typically expect vendor vulnerability acknowledgement within 48 hours and critical remediation timelines of 14 days. For medium/low we track 60/120 days respectively. If you have different windows, please call them out.
- Disclosure: Medisia requires a coordinated disclosure window of 30 days before any public notice for vulnerabilities that affect customer data; coordinated remediation updates are expected during that period.

We can do the intake meeting 9/29 11am PT — that works for me. I'll loop in our security lead Qamar (cc'ed).

—Lisa
Lisa Morales
Head of Product, Medisia Health
lisa.morales@medisia.com
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 24 Sep 2027 08:52:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo follow-up — SOC 2 / pen test and vuln ops next steps

Hi Lisa / Qamar — happy to join the intake. A few clarifications from our side before the call so we can prepare the right artifacts:

- Pen test artifacts: we can provide the most recent 3rd-party external pentest report (redacted to remove tester IPs and exploit POC where necessary) and our internal vuln scan summary (monthly Nessus/Qualys exports).
- SLA alignment: Redwood currently operates on these windows for customer-reported or 3rd-party-reported vulnerabilities:
  * Acknowledgement: 24 hours business
  * Critical remediation: hotfix/mitigation within 7 business days, patch within 30 calendar days (where applicable)
  * High: 30 calendar days
  * Medium/Low: 90/180 calendar days

If the 14-day critical window you mentioned is non-negotiable, we can propose a custom contractual SLA for Medisia (we have precedent for that on Dedicated/Enterprise contracts). For the intake, can you confirm whether Medisia considers CVSS > 9.0 as "critical" or if you use an internal severity mapping? That will help us align remediation timelines.

I'll bring the internal vuln ops runbook and a proposed disclosure timeline to the meeting. Marissa / Stephanie — I'll hand the technical material to you both to own the post-call deliverables.

Logan Wright
Head of Vulnerability Management, Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com
